annotations.title: Start with Christ: begin, next steps, reading plans

description: Begin: the tour (begin), next steps for a journey, reading plans, a plan for a need, or an invitation to bring one person. Example: {mode:"begin"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/start_with_christ. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

day.description: For reading_plans: which day to read in full (default 1).

invite_for.description: For bring_one: a first name or relationship ("my sister"); no contact details.

invite_kind.description: For bring_one: what the invitation is for (default come_and_see).

invite_message.description: For bring_one: the person's OWN words, kept verbatim at the start of the draft; no links or contact details.

journey.description: For next_steps: which journey to run.

language.description: For next_steps prayer_group_in_my_language. BCP-47 language code.

mode.description: The kind of answer. Leave out for a guide to the modes.

need.description: For for_my_need: what the person is looking for, in their words, 3 to 300 characters.

online.description: For for_my_need: true to prefer online options.

passage.description: For next_steps understand_and_live_a_passage: a reference, e.g. "Romans 12:1-2".

plan.description: For reading_plans: a plan name or a need it serves ("Learn to Pray", "anxious", "grief").

name: start_with_christ
